visualCharacteristics: Light/grey two-column intro banner. Left column holds a large heading, a supporting paragraph, and a group of CTA buttons; right column is a vertical stack of lifestyle images. Text and image columns sit side by side on desktop and stack on mobile.
contentPattern: Two cells: a text cell (heading + paragraph + button group) and an image cell (stack of images).
usage: Page-intro hero with headline, supporting copy, calls-to-action, and a supporting image group.
